overrides.//: The Prologue has no magazines or reloading, so the mask ships with the charge budget of the filter cartridge CDDA gives it as its default magazine; recipe tool rows spend those charges.

notes: recipesInclude is required for the survey's "unblocks" rows: tailors_kit and makeshift_pressure_cooker were both in whitelist/recipes.json exclude, so whitelisting the item alone does not enable them
recipe:pickaxe dropped from drift's unblocks (pickaxe is not whitelisted and sits in the Tools family's Excluded list); recipe:thermometer does not exist in CDDA
none of the first eight ids (drift .. thermos) is a battery tool; of batch 1 only wire_draw_machine needed an electricity.json profile (see below)
batch 1 of the resumed import: 20 tool ids added (28 staged in this group so far); none was enabled before staging

recipesInclude grew by gasoline_cooker / propane_cooker / acetylene_cooker: all three results were already whitelisted but their recipe keys sat in whitelist/recipes.json exclude, so whitelisting the lantern alone does not enable them
recipe:propane_lantern is deliberately not in recipesExpected: its only book is textbook_fabrication, which is not enabled, so the lantern stays loot-only (survey agrees)
recipe:funnel_separation is not expected either: it needs stopcock (uncraftable, plastic_molding) plus glassblowing_book, so the funnel is loot-only
recipe:qt_wire:wire_draw_machine stays in whitelist/recipes.json exclude per steel rule 9; of the wire variants only recipe:copper_wire:wire_draw_machine is claimed

none of the 20 is a battery tool: the three lanterns burn gasoline/propane/weldgas charges and are imported as recipe components, not as light sources (no electricity.json or portableLights row needed)

recipe:lc_wire:wire_draw_machine dropped from recipesExpected: with the machine enabled it still misses lc_steel_lump (a loot-only B row outside this batch); recipe:copper_wire:wire_draw_machine is the claimed one
recipe:propane_lantern is enabled and its components are obtainable, but it stays unclaimed because its only book (textbook_fabrication) arrives in a later batch; until then the lantern is loot-only

mask_filter override (initial_charges): its recipe tool rows spend filter charges, and the Prologue does not model the magazine CDDA fills it from, so the mask would be a dead tool at 0 charges. The override gives it the cartridge budget once; there is no reload, so a spent mask stays spent (same shape as the char_purifier B-step in the survey)

wire_draw_machine needed one game-data/electricity.json device profile (BATTERY_HEAVY, external, no passive qualities): its only recipe row asks for 100 tool charges and the machine is a battery tool in CDDA, so without a profile it could never satisfy the row (the angle_grinder B-step pattern). It has no qualities, so the un-powered fallthrough in Crafting.js hands out nothing
chem_potassium and chem_sodium stay hidden (coordinator decision 19.09): the syringe unblocks them, but one batch is 87.5 L / 175 L of liquid, far beyond any container the Prologue player owns.
batch 2 added 10 tools and containers (38 staged in this group); none was enabled before staging and none is a battery tool

socket_wrench_set, multitool, camping_multitool, honey_scraper, scalpel, plastic_bucket and camelbak have no CDDA recipe at all: they are loot-only by design, which is why they carry two loot rows each plus a discovery pool

recipe:toolbox_workshop_empty is the one claimed recipe with a charge-hungry tool row (welder 3600 / welder_crude 7200 / oxy_torch 180, and oxy_torch is not enabled). It is genuinely reachable: welder is loot in three tables and medium_storage_battery (10000 kJ) is both laboratory loot and craftable from the enabled manual_electronics / mag_electronics. A welder on the smaller enabled cells (heavy_plus 503 kJ, battery_car 3000 kJ) is not enough, so the toolbox is a late-game craft and stays loot-first
